class.name: IfcPersonAndOrganization
class.brief_description: Definition: Identification of a person within an organization. NOTE Corresponds to the following entity in ISO-10303-41: person_and_organization. HISTORY New entity in IFC Release 1.5.1

members.member: The person who is related to the organization.
The organization to which the person is related.
Roles played by the person within the context of an organization. These may differ from the roles in ThePerson.Roles which may be asserted without organizational context.
